name: Google Calendar for Omarchy
author: dawestheperson
description: Omarchy's clock with your Google Calendar in it: the next event in the bar, per-calendar chips and day/week/month views in the popup, quick add from anywhere, and reminders. Syncs through gcalcli on a schedule; nothing runs in the background.

barWidget.description: The stock date/time label and calendar popup, with your Google Calendar in it.

schema.label: Event in the bar
schema.description: "upcoming" always shows your next event from your own calendars, any day. "soon" shows an event from its earliest reminder until it ends; "name"/"time" show only one half. "next" shows today's next event. "off" shows only the clock.

schema.label: Quick add shortcut
schema.description: Opens the new-event card from anywhere. Leave empty to turn it off. A shortcut already in use is not taken.

schema.label: Show the calendar icon this many minutes ahead
schema.description: The icon appears this long before an event starts and stays until it ends. 0 turns it off.

schema.label: Hidden calendars
schema.description: Comma-separated calendar names to leave out. Calendars unticked in Google Calendar are already left out.
